title: Banner rows styled before the background reply; recent-session titles near-invisible on light
observed: In iTerm light the banner's recent-session title 'seed a prior session' drew at ~#e8e0ce on ~#f5f2ec (about 1.15:1). The banner was rendered in cli/tui.go before the terminal reported its background, so it kept the dark design ink.
expected: Banner rows use the background-aware text tokens.
